content.text:
Confirmed for the API’s available dated records. [Interest 1220](https://interests-api.parliament.uk/api/v2/Interests/1220) belongs to member 172, Ms Diane Abbott, and has `registrationDate: "2016-10-26"`.

I checked all 15 interests with expired entries included and children returned individually. Pagination with `Take=5` produced 5, 5, 5, then 0 items at offsets 0, 5, 10, and 15. No dated record precedes 1220. Interest 5222 has a null registration date, which limits the conclusion to the earliest **dated record available through this API**.

Direct evidence:

- [Complete member query](https://interests-api.parliament.uk/api/v2/Interests?MemberId=172&Type=Commons&ExcludeExpired=false&ExpandChildInterests=false&Skip=0&Take=20) reports `totalResults: 15`.
- [Before 26 October 2016](https://interests-api.parliament.uk/api/v2/Interests?MemberId=172&Type=Commons&ExcludeExpired=false&ExpandChildInterests=false&RegisteredTo=2016-10-25&Take=20) returns zero.
- [Through 26 October 2016](https://interests-api.parliament.uk/api/v2/Interests?MemberId=172&Type=Commons&ExcludeExpired=false&ExpandChildInterests=false&RegisteredTo=2016-10-26&Take=20) returns only 1220.
- [Official schema](https://interests-api.parliament.uk/swagger/v2/swagger.json) defines registration date separately from publication date. For 1220, interest publication is `2023-12-10`; its available register versions are dated `2024-03-18` and `2024-08-04`. The description says the trusteeship began in December 2015. None of those dates replaces the recorded registration date.
